origins.section: A LocalDateTime Is a Wall-Clock Reading, and the Same One in Two Zones Is Two Moments
plusMonths Clamps to a Shorter Month's Last Day, So Step From the First Date
LocalDate.parse and LocalDate.of Refuse Dates That Don't Exist
The Last Day of a Month Comes From an Adjuster, Not a Day Number

recorded.outcome:q-gym-chained-billing: Correct option b follows from lines 67-69: 'plusMonths changes the month and keeps the day if the new month has it ... clamped ... Nothing in a LocalDate records the 31st, so every later step starts from the 28th', and the chained output stays on the 28th (lines 60-63). Caveat: the page never says September has 30 days or that October has 31. The option's own text supplies the September clamp to the 30th; the rest is calendar knowledge.

recorded.prompt:q-webinar-column-moves-server:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-webinar-column-moves-server:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-webinar-column-moves-server:a: Refuted: Instant.from(call) throws 'Unable to obtain Instant from TemporalAccessor ... LocalDateTime' because 'the value doesn't say which clock it was read from' (lines 32, 37-38), and the two zones give two different instants (lines 30-31).
recorded.prompt:q-webinar-column-moves-server:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-webinar-column-moves-server:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-webinar-column-moves-server:b: Refuted: 'None of them holds a zone or an offset' (lines 7-8), so the value carries no UTC. The stem also says the job applies the server's zone, and the page shows that a different applied zone gives a different instant (lines 30-31, 40-41). Partly true: the page does not rule out a writer who meant UTC by convention. The option fails because the job applies the server zone, which comes from the stem rather than the page.
recorded.prompt:q-webinar-column-moves-server:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-webinar-column-moves-server:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-webinar-column-moves-server:d: Refuted on mechanism: 'no row changes' (line 41), and the code prints the unchanged reading '2026-03-27T09:00' for both zones while atZone(...) alone produces the differing instant (lines 18-20, 30-31). Partly true: the conclusion ('at a different moment') matches the correct answer. Only the reason is wrong, and 'shifts the stored value into its own zone' could be loosely read as describing atZone, so a reader could take the page as supporting it.
recorded.prompt:q-gym-chained-billing:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gym-chained-billing:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-gym-chained-billing:a: Refuted: 'plusMonths changes the month and keeps the day if the new month has it' (line 67). It does not add a day count, and 31 Jan + 1 month = 28 Feb (line 60), not +30 days. Partly true: the answer (the 30th) is the same as the correct option's. Only the reason is wrong, so the page refutes the reasoning, not the date.
recorded.prompt:q-gym-chained-billing:c: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-gym-chained-billing:c: Refuted: in the output, step 4 chained gives 2026-05-28 but first.plusMonths(4) gives 2026-05-31 (line 63), and 'Chained steps drift' (summary, line 173).
recorded.prompt:q-gym-chained-billing:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gym-chained-billing:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-gym-chained-billing:d: Refuted: 'Nothing in a LocalDate records the 31st, so every later step starts from the 28th' (lines 68-69). The chained March date is 2026-03-28 even though March has a 31st (line 61).
recorded.prompt:q-import-june-31:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-june-31:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-june-31:a: Refuted for LocalDate.parse(text): 2026-04-31 is refused, not clamped (line 129). Possible misreading: lines 139-141 say a custom ofPattern 'uuuu-M-d' resolves smartly and 'reads 2026-4-31 as 30 April', so a reader who mixes up the two could take the page as supporting a. The stem's LocalDate.parse(text) is the strict ISO path.
recorded.prompt:q-import-june-31:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-june-31:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-june-31:b: Refuted: 'Where SimpleDateFormat turned 30 February into 2 March (unit 7.3.1), the import now stops at the line with DateTimeParseException' (lines 137-138). Rolling over is the old behaviour, and parse refuses.
recorded.prompt:q-import-june-31:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-june-31:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-june-31:c: Refuted: the calendar check happens inside parse. The output shows parse itself throwing 'Invalid date' for 2026-02-29 and 2026-04-31 (lines 128-129), and 'the import now stops at the line' (line 138). Partly true: DateTimeParseException is a DateTimeException, but the page shows it at parse time, not at a later use.
recorded.prompt:q-cutoff-day-31:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cutoff-day-31:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cutoff-day-31:b: Refuted on reason: a LocalDate 'holds [no] zone or offset' (lines 7-8), and the page attributes the throw to the month lacking the day ('April has no 31st', line 101) and to 'the month's length' (line 104). The runs under UTC and Asia/Tokyo print the same lines because 'no example reads the default zone' (lines 9-10). Partly true: the conclusion (throws DateTimeException) is correct, and only the cause is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-cutoff-day-31:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cutoff-day-31:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cutoff-day-31:c: Refuted: withDayOfMonth throws rather than clamping (lines 98, 101-102), and the design note sets plusMonths clamping against 'withDayOfMonth(31) does in April' throwing (lines 208-209).
recorded.prompt:q-cutoff-day-31:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cutoff-day-31:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cutoff-day-31:d: Refuted indirectly: the page shows withDayOfMonth throwing for a day the month lacks (lines 98, 101-102), so it returns no date at all. The page does not mention rollover for withDayOfMonth specifically. It only contrasts rollover with SimpleDateFormat for parsing (line 137).
